title: Thai Herbal Wrap
description: A flavorful and refreshing Thai-inspired wrap made with herbal flavors and crispy vegetables.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken breast until cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing into thin strips.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced cucumber, carrots, and bell peppers.
Drizzle the herbal salad dressing over the top and toss to combine.
Warm the Portuguese-style flatbread according to package instructions.
Assemble the wrap by placing a few slices of grilled chicken on the flatbread, followed by a spoonful of the mixed greens salad.
Top with crushed peanuts and chopped cilantro.
